name: Starflask Media Studio
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools that let an agent generate media with Starflask (starflask.com) — images, video, 3D meshes, and speech — edit existing images (change/add/remove/restyle), convert video (mp4 → animated WebP/GIF) and image formats, plus upload source media, list models/styles, poll jobs, and check credits, all via a Starflask API key. Mirrors what the `npx starflask` CLI exposes.
